title: See Cirque du Soleil’s O at Bellagio
description: Take your seat at Bellagio and watch the stage become a pool, then a stage again. In O, acrobats, divers, synchronized swimmers, and aerial performers move through a dreamlike sequence built around water. You do not need to follow a plot; the changing depths, music, and impossible-looking entrances are enough to keep you leaning forward.
teaser: Watch acrobatics and diving meet on a water stage.
goodToKnow: This is a seated theater performance. Confirm the current schedule and seating before booking.
whyItMightDelightYou: The surprise comes from never being quite sure where the next performer will appear.
